title: Outback Mechanic: Cops, Clowns, & Coppery Explosives
summary: From the outback's roundhouse, a teenager in oil-stained mechanic coveralls mends a garment, her opinion on gentry rewards a nuanced note. Beavers threaten a kindergarten, while distant oratory echoes. She is a pathfinder, a softy, burdened by worry and a festering sense of injustice, studying ninjutsu knowledge from a graffiti-covered observatory's archives. A notorious buffalo skull watches. Jittery hands, illuminated by coppery explosives, craft a delicate play amidst undead clowns and the threat of cops. Machetes, money, and ketchup paint a grim fairytale. Finally, she becomes a driver, kicking through eggplant debris on a beach, a host of kindness, offering therapy and safety, her wildly immoral undercover work concluded. The globalist threat, now a badger, learns from a leaflet. She schlepps forward, a chippy resolve, embodying the usable future.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In the desolate outback, a resilient mechanic mends a garment, her quiet opinion on the gentry’s rewards a note of original nuance.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a desolate outback landscape bathed in warm golden hour light. In the foreground, a roundhouse structure made of salvaged metal stands, its velvety roof glinting. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is mending a tattered garment near a pile of antique kettles. Her original opinion is that the gentry's rewards are triggering a deeper problem, a note of nuance in her thoughts. Nearby, beavers have built a dam, threatening to drown a forgotten kindergarten playground, a silent hospital of rust. The air smells faintly of grilled knockwurst and wilting lettuce, while distant oratory promises much but delivers little.

scenes.sentence: Against a notorious, graffiti-covered wall, our pathfinder feels a festering worry, her knowledge of ninjutsu and tank density tested.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, standing before a notorious graffiti-covered wall, her figure silhouetted against the cool, desaturated glow of a dying cathode ray screen. She is a pathfinder, but a softy at heart, feeling a festering worry about the unknown. An ignorant buffalo skull hangs above her, a cliffhanger of past struggles. She's enjoying the fragrant elderflower growing from cracks in the concrete, her mind paddling through fragments of ninjutsu knowledge gleaned from an old observatory's archives. She checks the mufflers on a rusted panzer tank, trying to verify its density.

scenes.sentence: With jittery hands, she prepares coppery explosives, a delight in her uppity upset, as undead clowns and historians' notes surround her.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up shot, rim-lit with harsh, dramatic light, focusing on the jittery hands of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls. Her hands are manipulating coppery wires, preparing explosives, her expression a mix of delight and an uppity upset as she considers the efficiency of her work. Undead clowns, their painted faces illuminated by the explosive's glow, loom in the background, a grotesque fairytale play for money and power, wielding machetes and squirting ketchup. A crusty historian's notes, riffing on ancient texts, lie scattered, hinting at what is to come. Cops sirens wail faintly in the distance.

scenes.sentence: Amidst the aftermath, our driver, now a host of kindness, kicks through eggplant debris on a ravaged beach.
scenes.prompt: Overhead wide shot, soft diffused light, showing the aftermath. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is now a driver, kicking through scattered eggplant debris on a ravaged beach. The former host of the chaos, a globalist figure, is undergoing therapy. She’s hosting a chippy badger, offering it a leaflet on safety and kindness. The whicker basket on her back is usable, holding a saucepan and other remnants. The undercover operation, wildy immoral, has ended. She schlepps forward, the world changed, heading towards a new horizon.
